title: JavaScript Loops | Web Development in 60 Seconds
description:
Loops repeat instructions without writing the same code repeatedly. Learn javascript loops with a quick example for beginners.

A for loop can initialize a counter, check a condition, and update it.
Each pass through the loop is called an iteration.

Try it: Print the numbers from one through five with a loop.
